description: This file declares the CheckAudioUnderflow class, which is a task within the generic tasks namespace for the Rialto media server. It is responsible for checking audio underflow conditions in the media playback pipeline.

classes.name: CheckAudioUnderflow
classes.description: A class representing a task to check for audio underflow in the media player, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: CheckAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Constructor initializing the task with references to the player context, private player interface, client, and wrapper.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Method to perform the underflow check when invoked.
